content.title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross | Classic Christian Hymn | Choir & Organ with Lyrics | HAMBURG
content.text: Experience the timeless beauty of “When I Survey the Wondrous Cross,” sung to the classic tune HAMBURG in this moving choral arrangement. Written by Isaac Watts in 1707, this hymn broke new ground in English hymnody and remains one of the most beloved expressions of faith, reflection, and worship today. Recorded live by the Sunday 7pm Choir at St. Francis de Sales Parish in Ajax, Ontario, Canada. Thank you for listening and God bless! 🙏 Song Title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross Artist(s): Text by Isaac Watts, Tune - HAMBURG Publisher: Public Domain Where to Obtain Music: https://www.cpdl.org/wiki/index.php/W... Lyrics: When I survey the wondrous cross On which the Prince of glory died, My richest gain I count but loss, And pour contempt on all my pride. Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast, Save in the death of Christ my God! All the vain things that charm me most, I sacrifice them to His blood. See from His head, His hands, His feet, Sorrow and love flow mingled down! Did e’er such love and sorrow meet, Or thorns compose so rich a crown? Were the whole realm of nature mine, That were a present far too small; Love so amazing, so divine, Demands my soul, my life, my all. #God #lent #catholic #christianity #hymn #catholicchurch #catholicism #chant #gregorianchant #ashwednesday #holythursday #goodfriday #lentenmeditation #lentenreflection Thank you for listening to When I Survey the Wondrous Cross | Classic Christian Hymn | Choir & Organ with Lyrics | HAMBURG
